description: This file implements functions for initializing, deinitializing, and changing the volume/mix gain for an Amlogic audio hardware device within the SystemAudioPlayer project. It interacts with external hardware interfaces and manages audio device parameters.

methods.name: Soc_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Amlogic audio hardware device by loading the interface and checking initialization status.

methods.name: Soc_Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the audio hardware device by unloading the interface.

methods.name: SoC_ChangePrimaryVol
methods.description: Changes the primary volume by adjusting the mix gain parameter of the audio device based on the specified gain type and volume level.
